project.title: aquascape-rock-v2-views
project.description: Source-matched supplementary artwork for the accepted operator-reviewed V2 individual. Follow the exact master identity and pixel-art drawing.
project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.
project.session_goal: Source-matched supplementary views/parts for artwork-led 3D construction.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: rock_back
asset.description: View the EXACT same rock from the OPPOSITE BACK elevation. Orthographic camera level to its center, no top view and no underside, flat broad rear face toward viewer. Keep the same long low stone with a taller LEFT-hand shoulder in the master front view (it appears on viewer RIGHT from the back), stepped shelves and right notch. The reverse must look like the rear of the same connected mass, not a new stone. Show its previously hidden rear rock planes. IMPORTANT: exact same individual rock and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: Rear elevation of the exact same long, low aquascape stone from the master; its taller shoulder now reads on viewer right, with stepped shelves and the distinct notch preserved; previously hidden rear rock planes shown as one connected mass.
Silhouette: Identical long low horizontal profile, mirrored taller shoulder, crisp stepped shelf steps, notch kept readable; all tips fully inside frame.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Naturalistic detailed pixel art matching the master: crisp deliberate cluster edges, restrained earthy grey-brown palette, coherent painted volume, subtle facet shading.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic rear/back elevation, camera level with the stone's center, flat broad rear face toward viewer; no top-down angle and no underside.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio background, generous white margin, isolated stone with no ground contact, no cast shadow, no border or vignette; single image only.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No new or different rock shape, no front view, no top or underside view, no scenery, sand, plants, shadow, labels or text, no spritesheet or multiple frames, no transparency or checkerboard.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
